RELEVANT TABLES:
Table order_payments: One row per payment used on an order. An order can have several rows (split payments, vouchers).
- order_id: Joins to orders.order_id.

- payment_type: credit_card, boleto, voucher, debit_card or not_defined.
- payment_installments: Number of instalments chosen by the customer.
- payment_value: Amount paid in BRL for this payment row.
Table customers: One row per customer record. A customer_id exists per order; the real person is customer_unique_id.
- customer_id: Key used to join orders to customers. Different for every order, even for the same person.
- customer_unique_id: Identifier of the real person across orders. Count distinct values to count buyers. [SENSITIVE: aggregate only]
- customer_zip_code_prefix: First 5 digits of the customer's postal code. Approximate home area. [SENSITIVE: aggregate only]
- customer_city: Customer's city, lowercase Portuguese name.
- customer_state: Two-letter Brazilian state code, e.g. SP, RJ, MG.
Table orders: One row per order with its status and lifecycle timestamps. Central table of the database.
- order_id: Unique order identifier. Joins to order_items, order_payments and order_reviews.
- customer_id: Joins to customers.customer_id.
- order_status: One of created, approved, invoiced, processing, shipped, delivered, unavailable, canceled.
- order_purchase_timestamp: When the customer placed the order. Use this to assign orders to months.
- order_approved_at: When payment was approved. NULL if never approved.
- order_delivered_carrier_date: When the seller handed the parcel to the carrier. NULL if not shipped.
- order_delivered_customer_date: When the customer received the parcel. NULL if not delivered.
- order_estimated_delivery_date: Delivery date promised to the customer at checkout.
